message.about: Full-stack developer with three years of experience in Angular, React, Java Spring Boot and Python, including AI/LLM integration and microservices architecture. After a year in Japan (2023-2025) spent learning the language, back in France, in Rouen.

redlab.b1: Secure AI platform: Angular / Angular Material interfaces to configure multi-LLM prompts (OpenAI, Claude, VLLM), with dynamic parameters and conditional handling based on each provider's capabilities.

tropplus.b1: Event platform: website with an optimised search engine and a Vue.js back-office (event management and cashless payments).
tropplus.b2: 3 React Native mobile applications: QR code scanning (access control), real-time timing for sports events, cashless mobile payment.
tropplus.b3: Java Spring Boot + MongoDB REST API, microservices architecture for the secure processing of concurrent transactions.
tropplus.b4: Agile environment: Redmine, GitHub, continuous integration.
